{{Top|leg}}
'''Energy resistance''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used by many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], especially those fighting during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Its main effect was to create a barrier of energy-absorbent force around the user, reducing the damage taken from energy weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] may have known this power.

As the user became more powerful through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], they were able to learn and make use of advanced forms of energy resistance. This power was mainly used by [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] Jedi.

Another, more advanced version of energy resistance, allowed the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] to not only protect themselves but their allies as well. It granted immunity to poisons and disease, and absorbed a slightly higher amount of damage than energy resistance.

The technique was similar in usage and capabilties to that of [[Tutaminis]] and [[Force deflection/Legends|Force deflection]].
